description: Manages user notifications, including fetching, marking as read, and administrative updates.

endpoints.name: GetNotifications
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of notifications for the current user. Can filter to show only unread notifications.

unreadOnly.description: If true, only unread notifications are returned.

example_uses: Show me only my unread notifications.
List all notifications I have received.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to display a user's notification feed or to check for new, unread alerts.

endpoints.name: MarkAsRead
endpoints.description: Marks a specific notification as read for the current user to update notification status.

notificationId.description: Notification ID to mark as read

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user opens, reads, or acknowledges a notification to update its status.

endpoints.name: UpdateNotification
endpoints.description: Updates a notification's content and status for administrative or system management purposes.

request.description: Update request containing new message and status

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when administrators need to update notification content or status for system management.
